items.title: FinForesight: A Diagnostic Backtesting Benchmark for Deep Research Systems in Financial Forecasting
items.title_zh: FinForesight：金融预测深度研究系统的诊断回测基准
items.description: Anticipating financial outcomes requires synthesizing evolving evidence and reasoning under uncertainty, making deep research systems promising tools for forecasting. Yet evaluating forecasting ability is challenging because historical backtests may reward memorized outcomes or information retrieved after the forecast date. Live forecasting avoids direct access to realized outcomes, but feedback arrives only after events resolve. To obtain timely feedback and assess historical scores, we introduce FinForesight, a diagnostic backtesting benchmark for financial deep research systems. Across the Chinese, U.S., and Hong Kong markets, the benchmark evaluates four forecasting tasks: valuation, return ranking, event direction, and future financial fundamentals. Two capability diagnostic tasks assess counterfactual reasoning and financial calculation, scored separately from forecasting performance. Our harness-compatible framework restricts retrieved evidence to information available at the forecast date. We compare pretraining-era, resolved post-cutoff, and live evaluations to test whether controlled backtests approximate future performance. Pretraining-era scores exceed post-cutoff scores in most temporal comparisons, and stronger retrieval controls narrow the gap between post-cutoff backtests and live results. Forecasting attribution and robustness analyses reveal how scores respond to retrieval policy and how predictions respond to prompt rewrites and numerical perturbations. The code and benchmark data are publicly available.
items.description_zh: 预测财务结果需要在不确定性下综合不断变化的证据和推理，使深度研究系统成为有希望的预测工具。然而，评估预测能力具有挑战性，因为历史回测可能会奖励记忆的结果或预测日期后检索的信息。实时预测避免直接访问已实现的结果，但反馈只有在事件解决后才会到达。为了获得及时反馈并评估历史分数，我们引入了 FinForesight，这是一种针对金融深度研究系统的诊断回测基准。该基准在中国、美国和香港市场评估了四项预测任务：估值、回报排名、事件方向和未来财务基本面。两项能力诊断任务评估反事实推理和财务计算，与预测绩效分开评分。我们的线束兼容框架将检索到的证据限制为预测日期可用的信息。我们比较预训练时代、已解决的截止后和实时评估，以测试受控回测是否接近未来的表现。在大多数时间比较中，训练前时代的分数超过截止后分数，更强的检索控制缩小了截止后回测和实时结果之间的差距。预测归因和稳健性分析揭示了分数如何响应检索策略以及预测如何响应即时重写和数值扰动。代码和基准数据是公开的。
items.authors: Fengyuan Liu, Mukai Li, Jieshun You, Yilin Zheng, Chenjia Min, Yizhou Zhang, Harper Chen, Qi Liu

items.title: When Fine-Grained Credit Assignment Helps and Hurts: Multimodal Agentic Reinforcement Learning through Video Editing
items.title_zh: 当细粒度的信用分配有所帮助和有害时：通过视频编辑的多模式代理强化学习
items.description: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise for training multimodal agents to reason and use tools. However, it remains unclear when fine-grained credit assignment improves learning and when it fails to improve task performance. Video editing provides a useful testbed for this question, combining multimodal perception, long-horizon planning, and tool use with delayed outcome feedback. We construct four movie-trailer editing task types---Content Selection, Narrative Sequencing, Rough Cut, and Fine Cut---that reflect real-world editing workflows and span different levels of task complexity and interaction horizon. Decaying process rewards provides the largest benefit on Fine Cut, with a 45.4% relative gain over outcome-only GRPO on tasks averaging more than 60 turns under outcome-only GRPO. On the three shorter-horizon task types averaging 30--40 turns under the same baseline, outcome-only GRPO remains competitive, with decaying process rewards yielding at most a 10.4% relative gain. Process rewards from an LLM judge initially improve tool use and encourage visual inspection. As training progresses, however, GRPO+PRM with a fixed process-reward weight increasingly exhibits excessive reasoning and redundant tool calls: process rewards continue to rise while task completion rates and outcome scores decline. Decaying the process-reward weight to zero mitigates this reward-hacking behavior while preserving the early gains. Despite dense token-level supervision, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) yields little improvement or substantial degradation and is highly sensitive to the choice of privileged information. Our analysis reveals differences in teacher--student disagreement and gradient magnitudes, and suggests possible dilution of informative signals over long trajectories.
items.description_zh: 强化学习 (RL) 在训练多模式智能体推理和使用工具方面显示出良好的前景。然而，目前尚不清楚细粒度学分分配何时可以改善学习，何时不能提高任务绩效。视频编辑为这个问题提供了一个有用的测试平台，它将多模态感知、长期规划和工具使用与延迟结果反馈结合起来。我们构建了四种电影预告片编辑任务类型——内容选择、叙事排序、粗剪和精剪——反映了现实世界的编辑工作流程，涵盖了不同级别的任务复杂性和交互范围。衰减过程奖励为 Fine Cut 提供了最大的好处，在仅结果 GRPO 下平均超过 60 轮的任务上，与仅结果 GRPO 相比，相对增益为 45.4%。在相同基线下平均 30--40 轮的三种短期任务类型中，仅结果的 GRPO 仍然具有竞争力，随着过程奖励的衰减最多产生 10.4% 的相对收益。LLM评委的奖励流程最初可以改善工具的使用并鼓励目视检查。然而，随着训练的进展，具有固定过程奖励权重的 GRPO+PRM 越来越多地表现出过度推理和冗余工具调用：过程奖励持续上升，而任务完成率和结果分数下降。将过程奖励权重降低到零可以减轻这种奖励黑客行为，同时保留早期收益。尽管有密集的代币级监管，但策略自蒸馏（OPSD）几乎没有带来任何改善或大幅退化，并且对特权信息的选择高度敏感。我们的分析揭示了师生分歧和梯度大小的差异，并表明长轨迹上的信息信号可能会被稀释。
items.authors: Lei Zhao, Zongheng Cao, Xinyu Hu

items.title: Cross-Prompt Reuse of Entity-Replacement Responses
items.title_zh: 实体替换响应的交叉提示重用
items.description: With model weights fixed, we measure how much of an entity-replacement response transfers between English factual questions, beyond whether answers change. We add the hidden-state change from two source questions to a target question about the same entity, comparing the predicted log-probability shift between two relations' published answers, given known answer prefixes, with the measured one. Hidden reuse injects the aligned change at 50% depth before the target's remaining layers; direct reuse adds source output-score changes. With other-relation sources, hidden reuse removes 45% and 49% of no-change error on 0.5-1B Qwen and Llama. Gemma-2-2B removes 22% and passes one of three comparisons in plain text without its default beginning-of-sequence (BOS) token. A later protocol restoring it yields 58-68%, passing every comparison on three cohorts. Larger checkpoints, chat format and new entities show replication and format- or cohort-dependent failures. On small plain-format checkpoints, other-relation hidden reuse mainly reproduces the shift both relations' questions share, without reliably lowering relation-selective error. With target-relation sources, hidden reuse's post hoc advantage over direct reuse is 0.2-0.9 nats outside chat format, unconfirmed and not replacement-specific. The same relation-neutral change at both questions' entity tokens lowers relation-selective error more than random or other-replacement changes, indicating receiving-question dependence.
items.description_zh: 在模型权重固定的情况下，我们测量实体替换响应在英语事实问题之间转移的程度，而不仅仅是答案是否发生变化。我们将两个源问题的隐藏状态变化添加到关于同一实体的目标问题，将给定已知答案前缀的两个关系的已发布答案之间的预测对数概率变化与测量的答案进行比较。隐藏重用在目标剩余层之前的 50% 深度处注入对齐的更改；直接重用会增加源输出分数的变化。对于其他关系源，隐藏重用消除了 0.5-1B Qwen 和 Llama 上 45% 和 49% 的无变化错误。 Gemma-2-2B 删除了 22%，并以纯文本形式传递了三个比较之一，而没有默认的序列开始 (BOS) 标记。后来的恢复方案的收益率为 58-68%，通过了三个队列的所有比较。更大的检查点、聊天格式和新实体显示了复制和格式或队列相关的失败。在小型纯格式检查点上，其他关系隐藏重用主要重现两个关系的问题共享的转变，而不能可靠地降低关系选择错误。对于目标关系源，隐藏重用相对于直接重用的事后优势是聊天格式之外的 0.2-0.9 nat，未经确认且不特定于替换。两个问题的实体标记的相同关系中性变化比随机或其他替换变化更能降低关系选择错误，表明接收问题依赖性。
items.authors: Jinkun Chen, Xuemin Yu, Sijia Han, Vlado Keselj

items.title: SphereFlow: Missing Modality Imputation via Geometric Transport on Hypersphere
items.title_zh: SphereFlow：通过超球面上的几何传输进行缺失模态插补
items.description: Missing modality imputation aims to synthesize unobserved modalities from observed ones. Existing methods treat each modality as living on its own latent manifold, forcing the generator to learn a long, unstructured jump between them. We present SphereFlow, which takes a fundamentally different view: by projecting all modalities into a shared hyperspherical latent space via a frozen self-supervised encoder, cross-modal imputation reduces to short-range geometric transport between nearby points on the sphere. Realizing this idea with flow matching, however, exposes two geometric conflicts: the standard Gaussian noise source is catastrophically mismatched with the unit-norm data manifold, and the linear interpolation path departs the sphere surface into a region where the decoder has no training signal. We resolve both with simple, geometry-aware modifications: replacing the noise source with the observed-modality latent so that the velocity field learns only the cross-modal displacement, and training the decoder with a time-weighted loss that extends its domain to the near-surface region traversed by the flow. We prove that this data-as-source formulation reduces the worst-case off-manifold deviation from a quantity that grows with the latent dimension to a small, dimension-independent bound governed by inter-modality similarity. Experiments on BraTS multi-modal MRI imputation and CT-MRI translation demonstrate state-of-the-art generation fidelity across all settings, while downstream brain tumor segmentation with our imputed data closes roughly eighty percent of the gap to the full-modality oracle. Code is available at https://github.com/WTHH031230/SphereFlow.
items.description_zh: 缺失模态插补旨在从观察到的模态合成未观察到的模态。现有的方法将每种模态视为存在于其自己的潜在流形上，迫使生成器学习它们之间的长的、非结构化的跳跃。我们提出了 SphereFlow，它采取了根本不同的观点：通过冻结的自监督编码器将所有模态投影到共享的超球面潜在空间中，跨模态插补减少了球体上附近点之间的短程几何传输。然而，通过流匹配实现这一想法暴露了两个几何冲突：标准高斯噪声源与单位范数数据流形灾难性地不匹配，并且线性插值路径使球体表面离开球体表面进入解码器没有训练信号的区域。我们通过简单的、几何感知的修改来解决这两个问题：用观察到的潜在模态替换噪声源，以便速度场仅学习跨模态位移，并使用时间加权损失训练解码器，将其域扩展到流穿过的近地表区域。我们证明，这种以数据为源的公式将最坏情况下的流形偏差从随潜在维度增长的数量减少到由模态间相似性控制的小的、与维度无关的界限。 BraTS 多模态 MRI 插补和 CT-MRI 翻译的实验证明了所有设��中最先进的生成保真度，而使用我们的插补数据进行的下游脑肿瘤分割缩小了与全模态预言的大约 80% 的差距。代码可在 https://github.com/WTHH031230/SphereFlow 获取。
items.authors: Huihan Wang, Juncheng Wang, Yuxiang Feng, Wenlong Hou, Guoqi Yu, Chao Xu, Yang Liu, Baigui Sun, Shujun Wang

items.title: Length Is Cheap, Competition Is Not: Attention Predicts Context Rot in Retrieval
items.title_zh: 长度很便宜，竞争却不是：注意力预测检索中的上下文腐烂
items.description: Why do language models fail on long inputs? The common answer is length. We show that, for retrieval, length is cheap and competition is not. On five open models (0.5B to 3B parameters, four families), neutral filler costs nothing: accuracy stays at 0.97 to 1.00, up to 32K tokens on Qwen2.5-1.5B. Statements in the format of the evidence, placed at the same positions, drop it to 0.16 to 0.33. A single statement that gives the queried key a rival value multiplies the loss by 9 to 110, and every additional rival adds to it. Inside the model, one quantity tracks the failure: the attention mass left on the evidence. Across 126,473 trials it explains up to 58% of the variance in loss; log length explains at most 8%. The masked-filler protocol behind the claim that length alone hurts reproduces on MMLU (11 to 18 points lost at 30K tokens), but fails a visible control in retrieval: masking costs 45 accuracy points at 32K tokens, while the same filler left visible costs none. In retrieval, context rot is a competition for attention. We release the probe and all 126K trial-level measurements.
items.description_zh: 为什么语言模型在长输入时会失败？常见的答案是长度。我们表明，对于检索来说，长度是廉价的，而竞争则不然。在五个开放模型（0.5B 到 3B 参数，四个系列）上，中性填充物不花费任何成本：准确度保持在 0.97 到 1.00，Qwen2.5-1.5B 上最多 32K 令牌。证据格式的陈述，放置在相同位置，则将其降至 0.16 至 0.33。为查询的键赋予竞争值的单个语句会将损失乘以 9 到 110，并且每增加一个竞争者都会增加损失。在模型内部，有一个量追踪失败：证据上留下的注意力。在 126,473 项试验中，它解释了高达 58% 的损失方差；对数长度最多解释8%。声称长度本身会损害 MMLU 上的再现（30K 令牌丢失 11 到 18 点）背后的屏蔽填充协议，但在检索中未能实现可见控制：屏蔽在 32K 令牌时花费 45 个准确度点，而相同的填充留下可见成本则没有成本。在检索中，上下文腐烂是一种注意力的竞争。我们发布了探头��所有 126K 试验级测量结果。

items.title: QFabric: Guarded Cross-Domain Task Recovery and Its Limits on a Linux-RTOS Board
items.title_zh: QFabric：Linux-RTOS 板上的受保护跨域任务恢复及其限制
items.description: Heterogeneous embedded boards pair a Linux application processor with a real-time microcontroller (MCU), which suggests moving a task between the two domains when its timing degrades. We present QFabric, a prototype that treats cross-domain placement as guarded recovery from a violated empirical soft real-time contract: a bounded task is compiled for both domains, monitored in windows with hysteresis, switched only after semantic and capacity admission at a quiescent epoch boundary, and committed or rolled back after probation. On an Arduino UNO Q (Cortex-A53 Linux and a Cortex-M33 running Zephyr), we characterize the stock Bridge RPC interconnect and measure five workloads in both domains under idle, CPU-load, and higher-priority SCHED_FIFO contention, with ordinary and real-time callers. Each MCU invocation costs about 19 ms of dispatch regardless of compute, the MCU runs the heaviest kernel 34x slower, and because every call traverses Linux userspace, Linux contention inflates the MCU path far more than the Linux path (p99 up to 400 ms versus 17.0 ms). Across 30 cells of a four-node chain, Linux meets every contract within 0.8% misses and QFabric correctly never migrates; a controller without hysteresis migrates in 7 cells, raising p95 by up to 177x, and probation rolls back 5 of those moves. On Linux-dispatched heterogeneous boards, migration therefore cannot isolate a task from Linux interference, and recovery guards matter chiefly by preventing harmful moves. This paper supersedes an earlier artifact release whose reported improvement arose from measurement defects that we identify. All source, raw traces, and generators are public.
items.description_zh: 异构嵌入式板将 Linux 应用处理器与实时微控制器 (MCU) 配对，这建议当任务时序恶化时在两个域之间移动任务。我们提出了 QFabric，一种将跨域放置视为从违反的经验软实时合约中进行保护恢复的原型：为两个域编译有界任务，在带有滞后的窗口中进行监视，仅在静态纪元边界的语义和容量许可后进行切换，并在试用后提交或回滚。在 Arduino UNO Q（Cortex-A53 Linux 和运行 Zephyr 的 Cortex-M33）上，我们描述了库存 Bridge RPC 互连的特征，并测量了两个域中空闲、CPU 负载和更高优先级 SCHED_FIFO 争用以及普通调用者和实时调用者的五个工作负载。无论计算如何，每次 MCU 调用都会花费约 19 毫秒的调度时间，MCU 运行最重的内核速度要慢 34 倍，而且由于每次调用都会遍历 Linux 用户空间，Linux 争用使 MCU 路径的膨胀远远超过 Linux 路径（p99 高达 400 毫秒，而 17.0 毫秒）。在四节点链的 30 个单元中，Linux 在 0.8% 的遗漏率内满足每个合约，并且 QFabric 不会正确迁移；没有滞后的控制器会在 7 个单元中迁移，将 p95 提高高达 177 倍，并且试用期会回滚其中的 5 个移动。因此，在 Linux 调度的异构板上，迁移无法将任务与 Linux 干扰隔离开来，而恢复防护的作用主要在于防止有害的移动。本文取代了早期的工件版本，该版本报告的改进源于我们发现的测量缺陷。所有来源、原始痕迹和生成器都是公开的。

items.title: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
items.title_zh: 对抗性推测推理改进了长视野智能体
items.description: Speculative decoding has been treated purely as a systems optimization that speeds up large language model decoding without changing the model behavior. Under this view, the growing effort to train better draft models has been focused solely on acceptance rate. We argue that this view does not hold true for long-horizon agent reasoning. Measuring frontier open-weight models on complex agentic tasks with different speculative decoding approaches, we found that numerical noise grows within verification windows, and the draft acceptance results of the thinking process can change the output distribution of the model after 30 steps, thus noticeably influencing the reasoning accuracy of long-horizon agents in random directions. In this work, we improve the reasoning capability of target models by controlling such noise. While we cannot change the overall token distribution verified by the target model, we can encode critical reasoning with highest precision by training the draft model to be rejected. We identify these points in agent traces and train the draft model to favor adversarial preference. At inference the trained draft and the target part ways precisely at these decision points, verification restarts, so that critical thinking tokens are sampled from the target model and encoded under its least noisy conditions. This approach makes critical reasoning better indexed and more durable over a long horizon. On complex agentic coding benchmarks, our approach raises end-to-end success rate with no change to the target model or its output distribution. Our results recast the speculative decoding mechanism from a pure accelerator into an active allocator for context precision that improves the accuracy of long-horizon agents by training 0.06% to 0.28% of hosted parameters.
items.description_zh: 推测解码纯粹被视为一种系统优化，可以在不改变模型行为的情况下加速大型语言模型解码。根据这种观点，越来越多的训练更好选秀模型的努力仅仅集中在接受率上。我们认为，这种观点对于长期代理推理来说并不成立。使用不同的推测性解码方法测量复杂代理任务上的前沿开放权重模型，我们发现数值噪声在验证窗口内增长，并且思维过程的草稿接受结果可以在 30 个步骤后改变模型的输出分布，从而显着影响长视野代理在随机方向上的推理准确性。在这项工作中，我们通过控制此类噪声来提高目标模型的推理能力。虽然我们无法改变目标模型验证的整体令牌分布，但我们可以通过训练要拒绝的草稿模型来以最高精度编码关键推理。我们在代理追踪中识别这些点，并训练草稿模型以支持对抗性偏好。在推理时，经过训练的草稿和目标在这些决策点精确分开，验证重新启动，以便从目标模型中采样批判性思维标记，并在其噪声最小的条件下进行编码。这种方法使批判性推理能够更好地建立索引，并且从长远来看更持久。在复杂的代理编码基准上，我们的方法提高了端到端的成功率，而不改变目标模型或其输出分布。我们的结果将推测性解码机制从纯粹的加速器改造成上下文精度的主动分配器，通过训练 0.06% 到 0.28% 的托管参数来提高长视野代理的准确性。
items.authors: Hongyin Luo, Wei Fang, Lijie Yang, Owen Stepan, Daniel Suit, Jeff Krapf, Dana Wensberg, Jack O'Brien

items.title: BEND 2.0: Benchmarking the Capabilities Needed to Design DNA
items.title_zh: BEND 2.0：设计 DNA 所需能力的基准测试
items.description: Genomic foundation models are increasingly used to propose DNA sequences and edits. But successful design requires capabilities that current benchmarks do not measure. Here we introduce BEND 2.0 (BENchmark for DNA language models), which tests how well models predict the effects of DNA changes and whether these predictions can guide sequence design. Across eight tasks built on five experimental datasets, we find that model choice and how representations are accessed both affect performance. Linear readouts fitted to frozen representations can match or exceed models' native outputs, and functional post-training substantially improves the models' capabilities. Linear readouts transfer well across experimental assays and genes, suggesting that models capture functional patterns beyond the data used to fit individual predictors. At the same time, strong prediction of average effects can conceal weaker prediction of context-specific effects, and accurate prediction of combined mutation effects does not imply accurate prediction of their interactions. In design tasks, model predictions can reduce the number of candidates needed to find a desired response, but still leave substantial room for better design choices, particularly for context-specific and multi-cell objectives. Our benchmark reveals that genomic models now display signs of general utility but have yet to saturate on performance in even simple tasks.
items.description_zh: 基因组基础模型越来越多地用于提出 DNA 序列和编辑。但成功的设计需要当前基准无法衡量的功能。这里我们介绍BEND 2.0（DNA语言模型的BENchmark），它测试模型预测DNA变化影响的效果以及这些预测是否可以指导序列设计。在基于五个实验数据集的八个任务中，我们发现模型选择和表示的访问方式都会影响性能。适合冻结表示的线性读数可以匹配或超过模型的本机输出，并且功能性后训练大大提高了模型的能力。线性读数在实验测定和基因之间转移良好，这表明模型捕获了超出用于拟合个体预测因子的数据的功能模式。同时，对平均效应的强预测可以掩盖对上下文特定效应的较弱预测，并且对组合突变效应的准确预测并不意味着对其相互作用的准确预测。在设计任务中，模型预测可以减少找到所需响应所需的候选数量，但仍然为更好的设计选择留下了很大的空间，特别是对于特定于上下文的多单元目标。我们��基准测试表明，基因组模型现在显示出通用性的迹象，但即使在简单的任务中，性能也尚未达到饱和。
items.authors: Andreas Bjerregaard, Rachael DeVries, Dionysia Danai Brilli, Panagiotis Antoniadis, Yan Li, Anders Krogh, Wouter Boomsma, Ole Winther, Frederikke Isa Marin

items.title: Dory1.0-4B: A Looped Normalized-GPT
items.description: We introduce Dory1.0-4B, a 4-billion-parameter looped (latent-recurrent) language model with elastic depth: a single checkpoint serves different inference compute budgets. Dory1.0-4B is built on a normalized Transformer (nGPT) backbone with interleaved sliding-window and full-attention layers, organized into an input block, a shared recurrent block, and an output block. At inference, the recurrent block can be applied a variable number of times. We pre-trained Dory1.0-4B on 6 trillion tokens. The first 4.5 trillion tokens were trained in NVFP4, and additional pre-training then extended the context length to 256K tokens. Next, we post-trained the model using Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), with a difficulty-aware loop curriculum that routes harder prompts to deeper loops. Increasing the loop count improves accuracy, with the largest gains on coding, agentic, and long-context benchmarks. With two or more loops, Dory1.0-4B outperforms larger models such as Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma 4 12B, and Gemma 4 26B-A4B on average across 12 benchmarks. Looping also makes Dory1.0-4B more token-efficient on agentic benchmarks: with four loops, it generates 1.3-2.5x fewer tokens than with one loop, as the extra computation is spent in latent space rather than on longer outputs. To reduce memory during looping, Dory1.0-4B caches keys and values only from the last loop, keeping its KV-cache footprint equal to that of a non-looped model at any loop count while retaining most of the accuracy gains. We open-source the BF16, MXFP8, NVFP4, and GGUF quantized checkpoints.
items.description_zh: 我们引入了 Dory1.0-4B，这是一个具有弹性深度的 40 亿参数循环（潜在循环）语言模型：单个检查点服务于不同的推理计算预算。 Dory1.0-4B 构建在归一化 Transformer (nGPT) 主干上，具有交错的滑动窗口和全注意力层，组织为输入块、共享循环块和输出块。据推断，循环块可以应用可变次数。我们用 6 万亿个代币对 Dory1.0-4B 进行了预训练。前 4.5 万亿个令牌在 NVFP4 中进行训练，然后额外的预训练将上下文长度扩展到 256K 个令牌。接下来，我们使用监督微调（SFT）和具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）对模型进行后训练，并使用难度感知循环课程将较难的提示路由到更深的循环。增加循环计数可以提高准确性，在编码、代理和长上下文基准测试中获得最大收益。通过两个或更多循环，Dory1.0-4B 在 12 个基准测试中的平均性能优于 Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma 4 12B 和 Gemma 4 26B-A4B 等较大模型。循环还使 Dory1.0-4B 在代理基准上更具令牌效率：使用四个循环，它生成的令牌比使用一个循环少 1.3-2.5 倍，因为额外的计算花费在潜在空间而不是较长的输出上。为了减少循环期间的内存，Dory1.0-4B 仅缓存最后一个循环的键和值，在任何循环计数下使其 KV 缓存占用量与非循环模型的占用量相同，同时保留大部分精度增益。我们开源了 BF16、MXFP8、NVFP4 和 GGUF 量化检查点。
items.authors: Maxim Fishman, Simeng Sun, Shantanu Acharya, Faisal Ladhak, Brian Chmiel, Santiago Akle Serano, Ron Banner, Boris Ginsburg, Krishna C. Puvvada

items.title: Every Token Needs Its Own Teacher: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-distillation
items.title_zh: 每个代币都需要自己的老师：多老师自适应在策略自蒸馏
items.description: On-policy Self-distillation (OPSD) has proven effective for post-training large language models by constructing a teacher conditioned on privileged references. However, existing approaches keep the teacher fixed either throughout training by consistently exposing it to the full reference, or within each response by adaptively varying partial reference exposure only across responses. In this paper, we argue that neither of them is sufficient. Instead, every token needs its own teacher, as the teacher preference can vary token by token within the same response. Through a teacher-intervention pilot study, we validate that the teacher preference differs across tokens, and reveal that a preferred teacher can be identified for each token through majority voting and KL-based selection. Motivated by these findings, we propose Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation (MTA-OPSD), the first token-level adaptive OPSD method. Our method constructs a multi-teacher pool consisting of candidate teachers, and enables every token to adaptively select its preferred teacher during training. Experiments with Qwen3 models on mathematical reasoning tasks show that MTA-OPSD consistently outperforms existing OPSD approaches with an average gain of up to +5.9 over the base model, highlighting the importance of adapting teacher supervision at the token level. The code is available at https://github.com/xingzhejun/MTA-OPSD.
items.description_zh: 事实证明，通过构建以特权引用为条件的教师，按策略自蒸馏（OPSD）对于训练后大型语言模型是有效的。然而，现有的方法要么在整个训练过程中通过始终将其暴露于完整参考来使教师保持固定，要么在每个响应中通过仅在响应中自适应地改变部分参考暴露来固定教师。在本文中，我们认为它们都不够。相反，每个标记都需要自己的老师，因为老师的偏好可以在同一响应中逐个标记地变化。通过教师干预试点研究，我们验证了不同代币的教师偏好不同，并揭示��可以通过多数投票和基于 KL 的选择为每个代币确定首选教师。受这些发现的启发，我们提出了多教师自适应同策略自蒸馏（MTA-OPSD），这是第一个令牌级自适应 OPSD 方法。我们的方法构建了一个由候选教师组成的多教师池，并使每个令牌能够在训练期间自适应地选择其首选教师。在数学推理任务上使用 Qwen3 模型进行的实验表明，MTA-OPSD 始终优于现有的 OPSD 方法，与基本模型相比平均增益高达 +5.9，这凸显了在令牌级别调整教师监督的重要性。代码可在 https://github.com/xingzhejun/MTA-OPSD 获取。
items.authors: Yifu Luo, Chuang Ma, Zeyu Chen, Enkelejda Kasneci, Qi Chen, Gjergji Kasneci

items.title: Kierston & KierstonBench: Simulation of Allentown, PA and Evaluation of Language Models in Crime Investigation and Surveillance Tasks
items.title_zh: Kierston 和 KierstonBench：宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦的模拟以及犯罪调查和监视任务中语言模型的评估
items.description: Large language models are candidates for collecting and analyzing records in criminal investigations and mass surveillance. Their capability and accuracy in this work cannot currently be measured. Real deployments lack the ground truth needed to score a model's conclusions, and no benchmark evaluates these capabilities in a simulated environment. We present Kierston, a city-scale simulation engine, and KierstonBench, a benchmark that tests these capabilities against known simulated events. Kierston models approximately 125,000 residents of Allentown, Pennsylvania, generating their daily activities and the telecommunications, financial, administrative and license-plate records that surveillance and investigative systems collect about them. These records derive from a common behavioral timeline and are distributed across sources representing separate providers. Models investigate through a restricted records interface, linking observations across sources without access to the underlying simulation. The benchmark comprises 32 task families covering record linkage, routine reconstruction, incident investigation and assessment of deceptive accounts. In an evaluation of sixteen language models, most could not perform records investigation and submitted identifications the records did not support. A small number of frontier models solved most of the tasks and abstained when evidence was insufficient. In some cases these models still fell for common deceptions and assumptions, and none replaced an investigator.
items.description_zh: 大型语言模型是收集和分析刑事调查和大规模监视记录的候选者。目前无法衡量他们在这项工作中的能力和准确性。实际部署缺乏对模型结论进行评分所需的基本事实，并且没有基准可以在模拟环境中评估这些功能。我们推出了 Kierston（城市规模的模拟引擎）和 KierstonBench（根据已知模拟事件测试这些功能的基准）。 Kierston 对宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦的大约 125,000 名居民进行了建模，生成他们的日常活动以及监视和调查系统收集的有关他们的电信、财务、行政和车牌记录。这些记录源自共同的行为时间线，并分布在代表不同提供商的来源之间。模型通过受限记录界面进行调查，将跨来源的观察结果链接起来，而无需访问底层模拟。该基准包括 32 个任务系列，涵盖记录链接、日常重建、事件调查和欺骗性账户评估。在对十六种语言模型的评估中，大多数语言模型无法进行记录调查并提交了记录不支持的标识。少数前沿模型解决了大部分任务，并在证据不足时弃权。在某些情况下，这些模型仍然容易受到常见的欺骗和假设的影响，并且没有一个可以取代调查员。

items.title: Factorized MLLM Embeddings for Composed Image Retrieval
items.title_zh: 用于组合图像检索的分解 MLLM 嵌入
items.description: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image given a reference image and a modification text. Although recent approaches leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown significant progress, we argue that the MLLM's compositional understanding remains underutilized. This stems from directly mapping composed queries into a retrieval embedding via contrastive supervision alone, without explicitly resolving the intended visual modifications. In this work, we introduce Factorized MLLM Embeddings (FactEmbed), which decouples compositional query comprehension from building discriminative embeddings. Rather than directly projecting the composed query into a single embedding without internal reasoning, FactEmbed employs a set of factorized latents that simulate the intended visual modifications via an intermediate target imagination objective. This process encourages the latents to ground into target semantics before forming discriminative representations for retrieval. Subsequently, to propagate these factorized representations throughout the model for retrieval, we optimize a factor-level contrastive loss while distilling the decomposed representations into a deeper attention layer of the MLLM. Finally, for efficient inference, we retain the [EOS] token to establish a global-level embedding on top of these factorized latents, while we exploit the mean-pooled factorized latents to rerank a short candidate list at negligible cost, as both are produced by the same forward pass. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FactEmbed outperforms prior works across CIR benchmarks.
items.description_zh: 组合图像检索（CIR）旨在在给定参考图像和修改文本的情况下检索目标图像。尽管最近利用多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的方法已经取得了重大进展，但我们认为 MLLM 的组合理解仍未得到充分利用。这源于仅通过对比监督将组合查询直接映射到检索嵌入，而没有明确解决预期的视觉修改。在这项工作中，我们引入了因子化 MLLM 嵌入 (FactEmbed)，它将组合查询理解与构建判别性嵌入解耦。 FactEmbed 不是在没有内部推理的情况下直接将组合查询投影到单个嵌入中，而是采用一组因式分解的潜在变量，通过中间目标想象目标来模拟预期的视觉修改。这个过程鼓励潜伏在形成用于检索的区分性表示之前深入了解目标语义。随后，为了在整个模型中传播这些因式分解表示以进行检索，我们优化了因子级对比损失，同时将分解的表示提炼到 MLLM 的更深的关注层中。最后，为了高效推理，我们保留 [EOS] 令牌以在这些因式分解潜在变量之上建立全局级嵌入，同时我们利用均值池因式分解潜在变量以可忽略不计的成本对短候选列表进行重新���序，因为两者都是由相同的前向传递生成的。广泛的评估表明，FactEmbed 在 CIR 基准测试中的表现优于之前的工作。
items.authors: WonJun Moon, Seongchan Kim, Dahun Kim, Seungryong Kim

items.title: Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression
items.title_zh: 本地少思考：推理压缩的本地偏好学习
items.description: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance on challenging tasks, but their long chain-of-thought often incurs substantial inference costs by continuing to deliberate after sufficient information has been obtained. Existing reasoning compression methods primarily operate on reasoning trajectories, paying less attention to the local decision of whether further reasoning is necessary given the current state. We propose LoCo, a local preference learning method for reasoning compression. LoCo detects candidate overthinking states from the model's own traces, freezes the corresponding reasoning prefixes, regenerates shorter verified continuations from the same states, and trains on the resulting state-conditioned preference pairs with DPO. This formulation teaches the model when to continue reasoning and when to conclude, rather than simply encouraging shorter trajectories overall. We construct training data entirely from self-generated mathematical traces and evaluate LoCo on five mathematical and three code generation benchmarks. LoCo reduces completion length by 41.7\%--45.4\% on mathematics and 23.4\%--36.3\% on code, while maintaining or improving accuracy and achieving the best AUC across all code benchmarks. LoCo consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off on mathematics and transfers effectively to code generation despite math-only training, demonstrating the cross-domain generality of local preference learning for reasoning compression. The code and model will be publicly released at https://github.com/MuyaoYuan/LoCo.
items.description_zh: 大型推理模型在具有挑战性的任务上表现出色，但其较长的思维链往往会在获得足够信息后继续深思熟虑，从而产生巨大的推理成本。现有的推理压缩方法主要对推理轨迹进行操作，较少关注在给定当前状态下是否需要进一步推理的局部决策。我们提出了 LoCo，一种用于推理压缩的局部偏好学习方法。 LoCo 从模型自身的轨迹中检测候选过度思考状态，冻结相应的推理前缀，从相同状态重新生成更短的经过验证的延续，并使用 DPO 对生成的状态条件偏好对进行训练。这个公式教导模型何时继续推理以及何时得出结论，而不是简单地鼓励整体上较短的轨迹。我们完全根据自生成的数学轨迹构建训练数据，并在五个数学基准和三个代码生成基准上评估 LoCo。 LoCo 将数学上的完成长度减少了 41.7\%--45.4\%，将代码上的完成长度减少了 23.4\%--36.3\%，同时保持或提高了准确性，并在所有代码基准测试中实现了最佳 AUC。尽管仅进行数学训练，LoCo 仍不断改进数学的准确性与效率权衡，并有效地转移到代码生成，这证明了推理压缩的局部偏好学习的跨域通用性。代码和模型将在https://github.com/MuyaoYuan/LoCo公开发布。
items.authors: Muyao Yuan, Liyan Xu, Weizhan Zhang, Muyan Jiao, Jiangnan Li, Jinchao Zhang, Jie Zhou

items.title: You don't need long context
items.title_zh: 你不需要很长的上下文
items.description: Later tokens are costlier to generate than earlier tokens. On frontier open weight models, the disparity in cost may rise to as much as 7x. Through frequent compaction, we show across a broad range of long-horizon and long-input tasks that frontier language models sacrifice little to no task accuracy when maintaining short contexts. We further demonstrate that LLM performance does not collapse on long-horizon software engineering tasks even when taking at most one action per context, and based on that we outline the concept of semantic state space models (SSSMs). Our findings question the need for long-context language models.
items.description_zh: 后来的代币的生成成本比早期的代币更高。在前沿开放重量模型上，成本差异可能高达 7 倍。通过频繁的压缩，我们在广泛的长视野和长输入任务中展示了前沿语言模型在维护短上下文时几乎没有牺牲任务准确性。我们进一步证明，即使在每个上下文最多执行一个操作时，LLM 性能也不会在长期软件工程任务中崩溃，并在此基础上我们概述了语义状态空间模型（SSSM）的概念。我们的研究结果质疑长上下文语言模型的必要性。
items.authors: Peter Belcak, Saurav Muralidharan, Jindong Jiang, Yonggan Fu, Wonmin Byeon, Hanrong Ye, Ryan Angilly, Ali Taghibakhshi, Shih-Yang Liu, Siru Ouyang, Greg Heinrich, Pavlo Molchanov

items.title: GigaSpeech 3: Scaling Multi-Dialect Arabic Speech Recognition with Weakly Labeled Data
items.title_zh: GigaSpeech 3：使用弱标记数据扩展多方言阿拉伯语语音识别
items.description: Dialectal Arabic speech recognition remains constrained by the scarcity of dialect-resolved transcribed speech despite the abundance of web audio. We introduce GigaSpeech 3, a corpus of 39,000 hours and 10 million weakly transcribed speech segments covering Algerian, Egyptian, Iraqi, Saudi, and Syrian Arabic. Starting from 60 hours of manual transcription per dialect, we train labeling models using speech-recognition-biased self-supervised learning and apply them to dialect-matched web audio. Data selection and four rounds of noisy-student refinement for Saudi and Syrian Arabic yield the final corpus. We validate its utility through dialect-specific and multi-dialect speech recognition training and cross-domain evaluation. On GigaSpeechBench, the final dialect-specific models outperform their labeling models across all five dialects and achieve a macro-average word error rate of 23.86%, a 16.6% relative reduction from the strongest third-party system covering all five dialects, while outperforming the best third-party result on three dialects. A multi-dialect model using self-predicted dialect identities achieves a macro-average word error rate of 25.51% while also supporting Modern Standard Arabic. Across eight conditions from three external corpora, a GigaSpeech 3-trained Zipformer achieves the lowest word error rate among six evaluated models in every condition, while adapting the Qwen3 speech recognizer on GigaSpeech 3 improves performance across all eight conditions. We release the corpus and recipes as a foundation for dialect-aware Arabic speech processing.
items.description_zh: 尽管网络音频丰富，但阿拉伯语方言语音识别仍然受到方言解析转录语音稀缺的限制。我们推出了 GigaSpeech 3，这是一个包含 39,000 小时和 1000 万个弱转录语音片段的语料库，涵盖阿尔及利亚语、埃及语、伊拉克语、沙特语和叙利亚阿拉伯语。从每种方言 60 小时的手动转录开始，我们使用基于语音识别的自监督学习来训练标签模型，并将其应用于方言匹配的网络音频。针对沙特和叙利亚阿拉伯语的数据选择和四轮嘈杂学生细化产生了最终语料库。我们通过特定方言和多方言语音识别训练和跨域评估来验证其实用性。在 GigaSpeechBench 上，最终的方言特定模型在所有五种方言上都优于其标记模型，宏观平均单词错误率为 23.86%，比涵盖所有五种方言的最强第三方系统相对降低了 16.6%，同时在三种方言上的表现优于第三方的最佳结果。使用自我预测方言身份的多方言模型实现了 25.51% 的宏观平均单词错误率，同时还支持现代标准阿拉伯语。在来自三个外部语料库的八个条件下，经过 GigaSpeech 3 训练的 Zipformer 在每个条件下的六个评估模型中实现了最低的单词错误率，同时在 GigaSpeech 3 上采用 Qwen3 语音识别器提高了所有八个条件下的性能。我们发布语料库和配方作为方言感知的阿拉伯语语音处理的基础。
items.authors: Junzhe Liu, Yujie Tu, Yifan Yang, Peng Wang, Haoran Wang, Guodong Lin, Leyan Liao, Chengquan Zhang, Zhifu Gao, Xiangang Li, Qinyuan Cheng, Xipeng Qiu, Wei-Qiang Zhang, Guoguo Chen, Kai Yu, Xie Chen
